path_base: home directory; every file, target, and group-manifest path is relative to it

selection.policy: Existing approved selection preserved; skills are real directories under .agents/skills, personas and native wrappers are real files under .agents/agents/ecc. No credentials, global settings, hooks, services, or automatic updates are managed by this ECC manifest.

file_hash_normalization: Before SHA-256, replace the absolute deployment home directory in UTF-8 file bytes with the literal ${HOME}. Files without that path are hashed unchanged. The manifest excludes its own hash.

layout.claude_skills: .claude/skills/ecc-* symlinks; OpenCode, OMP, Codex, and Pi use the shared skill root

verification_scope: This is portable desired-state provenance, not proof of discovery on a new machine. Run native discovery after applying on each machine. Live integration authorization is machine-local.
removal_policy: Remove only recorded paths whose normalized hashes or symlink text still match. Never remove an entire harness configuration directory or unrelated skills.
